name: bhtop
description: A live NoC traffic monitor for Blackhole, like `top` but for the network-on-chip. It polls the free-running NIU performance counters on every tile over PCIe via `tt-exalens`, diffs successive samples, and draws per-tile, per-NoC bandwidth on either the physical die floorplan or the logical folded-torus (noc0) layout, with overlays for fold-seam distance and DRAM affinity. Companion commands inject host traffic to trace routes (`bhtop-inject`), run tt-metal NoC benchmarks and map where they land on the die (`bhtop-metal`), and serve a FastAPI + Svelte web cockpit (`bhtop-web`) that also deploys kernels to Tensix and the X280 L2CPU cores. Written in Python with Textual.
author: dtsunami
